endpoints.StopOwnedEntry: Original owner confirmed inside Controller stop lock (probe type 5).
endpoints.CancelReturnUpperBound: RunControl.cancel returned including its hooks (probe type 6); upper bound on cancellation observation, not the epoch mutation instant.
endpoints.StopReturn: Controller stop publication call completed, observed by the pre-return probe (type 7); not an observation after the method returned.
endpoints.ControlGoneObservedUpperBound: Test observed the stop control gone; polling upper bound, not a complete UI frame.
endpoints.StoppedFrameCompletion: MODEL only: original first natural stopped-state FrameMetrics INTENDED_VSYNC_TIMESTAMP + TOTAL_DURATION; HWUI completion, not physical presentation.
endpoints.PlatformCallReturn: DEVICE only: original platform API actually returned (probe type 2), distinct from target effect and ticket settlement.
endpoints.FixtureBarrierExit: DEVICE only: target Fixture hold exited; this is not platform API return.
endpoints.TargetEffect: DEVICE only: original target increment was written, possibly after stop.
endpoints.TicketSettled: DEVICE only: original platform call returned and its dispatch ticket closed (probe type 4); the surrounding worker may still be returning through its call stack.
endpoints.ReplyWriteAttempt: MODEL only: held server attempted its reply after explicit release; does not prove client consumption.
endpoints.ReplyWriteEnd: MODEL only: held server write attempt ended; includes deliberate hold and is not model cancellation latency.

limitations: One source commit, run, attempt and named profile. Each API and DEVICE/MODEL scenario retains its own denominator and distributions; no pooled P95 is computed.

Primary intervals start immediately before ACTION_UP injection and include injection/dispatch overhead. Intervals from the actual target button's touchUp receipt are reported separately. DOWN is preparation, not the response start.
All derived intervals use System.nanoTime/CLOCK_MONOTONIC. Raw elapsedRealtime/BOOT clocks and PerformanceTrace events remain separate and are never subtracted from MONOTONIC timestamps.
Cancel-return includes synchronous cancellation hooks and is an upper bound on cancellation observation, not the exact epoch linearization instant.

Control disappearance is a polling observation. Only MODEL measures the first natural stopped-state HWUI frame; DEVICE overlay disappearance supplies no complete-frame latency. HWUI completion is not physical display presentation.

The original in-flight DEVICE action may produce its one target effect after stop. Barrier exit, effect, API return, ticket settlement and eventual Controller/NETWORK/CLOSER worker drain are distinct. Late held-model writes do not prove that the client consumed the reply.
Only strictly valid passed original trials enter distributions. Failed trials retain observed intervals separately; missing and unexecuted slots remain explicit and no trial is replaced.
P95 is nearest rank ceil(0.95*n), only for formal groups with at least 100 valid original samples for that metric. Pilot data and a 99-sample prefix never supply P95.
Original run, job, instrumented-case, report and collection conclusions remain separate. Valid numeric samples do not turn a failed source attempt into a completed formal diagnostic.

Repeated samples on an emulator are not independent devices. Local file hashes and semantic validation do not authenticate GitHub independently. This is not physical-device, real-model, all-workload, full-suite, energy, thermal or performance-budget acceptance.
